stem.text: A uniform rod of length $30\,\text{cm}$ and weight $5.2\,\text{N}$ is attached to a wall by a hinge at one end.
The other end of the rod is supported by a wire so that the rod is horizontal and in equilibrium.
The wire is at an angle of $40^{\circ}$ to the horizontal.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal rod hinged to a vertical wall at its left end, with a wire joining the top of the wall to the far end of the rod, labelled wire, and the angle 40° marked between the wire and the rod. The rod is labelled rod and a dimension of 30 cm is marked along its length, with the hinge labelled hinge.
